entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, about time! I want to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! I ordered a large and this thing is way too tight. It's unwearable! I've been a loyal customer for years, and this is the quality I get? This is garbage. Get me your manager.

I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize that the sizing wasn't right. There's no need for a manager; I have the authority to resolve this for you right now. I've pulled up your account and I see the order. You're well within the 90-day return window.
So? What are you going to do about it? I'm not paying to ship this back.
Of course not. We can absolutely process a return or an exchange for you, free of charge. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a larger size?
I guess an exchange. But this whole experience has been a massive waste of my time. You can bet I'll be leaving a review about this.

I'm processing that exchange for you now. And because you're a VIP member and we value your business, I'd like to apologize for the inconvenience by upgrading the shipping on your new jersey to complimentary 1-day express. I'm also adding a $30 credit to your account for you to use on a future purchase.
Oh. One-day shipping? And a thirty dollar credit? Well... that's... actually very helpful. Okay. Thank you, that's much better.

You are very welcome. I've just confirmed that. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid return label for the original jersey and a confirmation for your new order within the next five minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for fixing it.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
